```sql
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  COUNT(*) AS double_doubles
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" p
WHERE p.game_date LIKE '2017%'
  AND p.played = 1
  AND (
        (CASE WHEN p.pts >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN p.reb >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN p.ast >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN p.stl >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN p.blk >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) >= 2
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY double_doubles DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
